reviews.shade: [Limited Set] goodal Heartleaf Calming Mineral Filter Sun Cream 50mL 1+1 Special Set
reviews.text: i dont use mineral sunscreen anymore but i get this one for my brother who has sensitive skin to chemical sunscreen. he loves this one because it is not irritating and it applies really nicely even though it is a mineral sunscreen
reviews.zh: 我已經唔再用礦物防曬，但係幫我阿哥買咗呢支，因為佢對化學防曬敏感肌。佢好鍾意呢支，因為雖然係礦物防曬但完全唔刺激，而且好易推開。

reviews.shade: [Limited Set] goodal Heartleaf Calming Mineral Filter Sun Cream 50mL 1+1 Special Set
reviews.text: It calms down my skin at first, evens out my skin tone but I’m not sure if it’s because of the white cast. It’s a bit too thick for me and doesn’t leave my skin very hydrated after a few hours, wouldn’t purchase again
reviews.zh: 初初用係有舒緩到皮膚，膚色都均勻返，但唔知係咪因為泛白嘅關係。對我嚟講有少少太厚，幾個鐘之後皮膚都唔夠保濕，唔會再回購。

reviews.shade: [Limited Set] goodal Heartleaf Calming Mineral Filter Sun Cream 50mL 1+1 Special Set
reviews.text: I've been using this sunscreens for a while now and it's always my go to. I've been struggling with acne and sensitive skin and this sunscreen never breaks out and doesn't make me feel cakey. It doesn't really have scent or so. if you have sensitive acne skin you should try this sunscreens.
reviews.zh: 我用咗呢支防曬一段時間，一直都係我嘅首選。我一直受暗瘡同敏感肌困擾，但呢支防曬從來都唔會令我爆瘡，搽完都唔會有厚粉感。基本上冇乜味道。如果你有敏感同暗瘡肌，一定要試下呢支防曬。

reviews.shade: [Limited Set] goodal Heartleaf Calming Mineral Filter Sun Cream 50mL 1+1 Special Set
reviews.text: It seems like a really good mineral sunscreen! at first, there is a slight white cast but once it absorbs it goes away. the smell is not bad. The finish is more of a semi-matte finish. So if you have dry skin like me, make sure to prep it well before applying in the winter.
reviews.zh: 似乎係一支好正嘅礦物防曬！初初會有少少泛白，但吸收完就會退。味道都唔錯。妝效比較似半霧面。所以如果你好似我咁係乾性肌，冬天用之前記得做好打底。

reviews.shade: [Limited Set] goodal Heartleaf Calming Mineral Filter Sun Cream 50mL 1+1 Special Set
reviews.text: This is one of the best sunscreens I’ve tried for sensitive skin. The texture is super lightweight and absorbs quickly without leaving any white cast or stickiness. It feels more like a moisturizer than a traditional sunscreen, which makes it perfect for daily use. I love that it’s packed with heartleaf extract—it really helps calm any redness or irritation. Plus, it layers beautifully under makeup and never clogs my pores. A gentle, hydrating, and calming formula that does exactly what it promises!
reviews.zh: 呢支係我試過最適合敏感肌嘅防曬之一。質地超輕透，吸收得快，唔會泛白又唔會黏笠。感覺上似保濕霜多過傳統防曬，所以好適合日日用。我好鍾意佢加入咗大量魚腥草萃取——真係可以幫助舒緩泛紅同刺激。而且搽完化妝超貼服，從來都唔會塞毛孔。溫和、保濕、舒緩，做到佢應承嘅嘢！

reviews.shade: [Limited Set] goodal Heartleaf Calming Mineral Filter Sun Cream 50mL 1+1 Special Set
reviews.text: My current favorite sunscreen. I have sensitive skin and cannot use chemical sunscreens since they cause me to breakout, and I’ve been searching for a good mineral sunscreen for a while, and I finally settled on this one. It does not leave a noticeable white cast, it’s easy to spread and apply, and it does not leave my skin feeling too matte, and it actually works well with makeup, which I found to be rare for mineral sunscreens. Will continue to repurchase!
reviews.zh: 而家我最鍾意嘅防曬。我有敏感肌，用唔到化學防曬，因為會爆瘡，所以搵咗好耐好嘅礦物防曬，最後揀到呢支。唔會有明顯泛白，夠易推同易搽，用完皮膚唔會覺得太霧，仲同化妝品好夾，對礦物防曬嚟講好難得。會繼續回購！

reviews.shade: [Limited Set] goodal Heartleaf Calming Mineral Filter Sun Cream 50mL 1+1 Special Set
reviews.text: Very pure ingredients, like it , no smell , it good also when you used perfume. I like consistency, very soft , no oily, I have problem skin with acne , but this product really good for my skin. Only one remark, I need to apply it twice
reviews.zh: 成分好純淨，我鍾意，冇味，搽完香水再用都冇問題。我鍾意佢嘅質地，好柔軟，唔油笠，我皮膚有暗瘡問題，但呢個產品對我皮膚真係好有用。唯一要講嘅係我要搽兩次。

reviews.shade: [Limited Set] goodal Heartleaf Calming Mineral Filter Sun Cream 50mL 1+1 Special Set
reviews.text: Due to my acne prone, very red and sensitive face, I’ve been searching for a good mineral sunscreen. Chemical sunscreens raise the temperature of my face and that’s no good if I want my makeup to stay on all day. Also because of the increased temperature, they leave my skin dry. This mineral sunscreen is calming, hasn’t irritated my skin and it even moisturizes. This item is a must before I put on my makeup.
reviews.zh: 因為我容易生暗瘡、面紅同敏感肌，所以我一直喺搵一款好嘅礦物防曬。化學防曬會令塊面升溫，如果我想妝容keep到全日就完全唔掂。而且因為面溫上升，塊面會變乾。呢隻礦物防曬有舒緩效果，冇刺激到我塊面，甚至有保濕。化妝前我一定會用呢個產品。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
